scope: offline source parity; no neural inference; phase contribution is algebraic only and makes no stochastic aspiration phase-recovery claim
source_decomposition_note: not exported: the generator returns only the final composite target and recipe; this bundle must not be described as a component-stem decomposition
metric_definition: strict cutoff < f < 8000 Hz; normalized f64 rFFT; one-sided Parseval weights; |Y-T|^2 = (|Y|-|T|)^2 + 2|Y||T|(1-cos phase delta); phase fraction is descriptive algebra, not recovered-phase evidence; relative NMSE null at target power <=1e-14, absolute terms retained

manufactured_mid_damage.metric_scope: archived values are original Rust f32; newly computed values are NumPy f64 rFFT/n with one-sided Parseval weights

healthy_fullband_forced_head.metric_scope: archived values are original Rust f32; newly computed values are NumPy f64 rFFT/n with one-sided Parseval weights

cases.historical_fingerprint_limit: FNV is a noncryptographic parity check, not audit authentication; SHA256 pins cover source bundle and old Euler8 files.
